> ## Summary
>
> - Closes #868. `server/config.test.ts` was 910 lines against the `max-lines` rule of 500, and its `withEnv` helper at `:279-297` mutated `process.env` in violation of `node/no-process-env`. Together those two findings made the pre-commit gate refuse every edit to the file, so any future change to configuration tests was blocked behind this split.
> - Split along the existing `describe` boundaries into three files, each under 500 lines: `server/config.test.ts` keeps the boundary, optional-secret, and `EMBEDDING_API_KEY` blocks; `server/config-extended.test.ts` takes the `extendedConfig` helper and the extended env group blocks; `server/config-equivalence.test.ts` takes the start-equivalence reader comparisons and the shared-namespace helper block.
> - The fourth block no longer touches `process.env`. `parseServerConfig(environment)` at `server/config.ts:380` is the pure reader that `loadServerConfig` feeds `process.env` into, so a local `parseFrom` helper builds the same environment shape as a plain object, calls `parseServerConfig`, and throws a `server_configuration_invalid` error naming the failing field when the parse fails. The four tests keep their assertions unchanged, including the `toThrow(/server_configuration_invalid.*DB_HOST/)` match.
> - Every test and assertion moved verbatim; only imports and the env helper changed. No test file reads or writes `process.env` after this. `server/config.ts` and `.oxlintrc.json` are untouched.
